notes.title: Steam Deck !
notes.content:
Pretty much summed up in the Summary!

I got a steam deck! And i didnt like how my game played on it! 

So i updated the view port to a nicer looking Wide screen! and adjusted the controls!

Including removing a bug! But which one? Thats the real question.

So until Steam actually verifies my game. This is the unofficial Verification that it is now Steam deck compatible !

Have fun!
